answer: Every agent starts each day at dawn with an empty karst ledger: a branching cave of verified jobs where each finished job issues one cipher-sealed receipt chained to the last, and only receipts earned by real work open the next cave level. A sybil attacker must push 200 clones through 200 separate job chains, posting a 50-coin bond per clone plus 40 hours of real compute per chain, so 200 clones cost 10,000 coins and 8,000 hours before earning anything, and one forged receipt burns the whole bond of that clone.
